categories.main_business_segments: Yodogawa Steel Works operates four main business segments: steel sheet-related business (including cold-rolled and surface-treated steel sheets, building materials, and exterior products), roll business (manufacturing and sales of steel and non-ferrous rolls), grating business (manufacturing and sales of steel gratings), and real estate business (leasing and sales of owned land and buildings). The company also engages in ancillary businesses such as logistics, warehousing, sports facility management, machinery plant sales, and solar power generation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include advanced surface treatment (such as hot-dip galvanizing and color coating), continuous production lines for steel sheets, and high-precision roll manufacturing. It emphasizes chromate-free and environmentally friendly processes, high-strength and lightweight steel products, and the development of insulated and disaster-resistant building materials. Production is supported by ISO-certified quality management and environmental management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction and building material companies, exterior product distributors, appliance manufacturers, and industrial clients requiring steel sheets and rolls. Major end markets are the construction, housing, infrastructure, and manufacturing sectors, both in Japan and internationally, with significant sales to trading companies such as Sadoshima Co., Ltd.
categories.geographic_coverage: Yodogawa Steel Works has a strong domestic presence in Japan with major plants in Osaka, Kure, Ichikawa, and Fukui, and significant overseas operations in Taiwan, China, and Thailand. Sales are distributed across Japan, Taiwan, and other Asian countries, with some exports to North America and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the steel supply chain, processing raw steel into value-added products such as coated steel sheets, building materials, and rolls, and supplying these to manufacturers, builders, and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the profitability of core businesses, expanding into new fields based on existing technologies, and building a sustainable management foundation. R&D focuses on high-value-added steel products (especially premium color-coated sheets), environmentally friendly and disaster-resistant building materials, and digital transformation (DX) and sustainability initiatives such as CO2 reduction and renewable energy adoption.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products (steel sheets, building materials, rolls, gratings), as well as through real estate leasing and sales, logistics services, and electricity sales from solar power. Revenue is recognized mainly at the point of delivery or completion of contractual obligations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yodogawa Steel Works is an independent steel manufacturer with a unique position in surface-treated steel sheets and downstream building materials, holding top market shares in certain product categories in Japan. Major competitors include other Japanese steelmakers (such as JFE, Nippon Steel) and regional players in Asia. The company differentiates itself through its technological expertise in surface treatment and its strong presence in both steel and building materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥208.5 billion, with operating profit of ¥13.9 billion and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥13.5 billion. The company has maintained stable growth in recent years, with a strong balance sheet (equity ratio over 70%) and a workforce of approximately 2,400 employees. The company exceeded its mid-term profit targets and continues to invest in growth and sustainability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yodogawa Steel Works emphasizes high-quality, high-performance steel products with advanced surface treatments, environmentally friendly and disaster-resistant building materials, and reliable supply capabilities. Its value proposition centers on technological innovation, product durability, environmental responsiveness, and the ability to provide integrated solutions from steel processing to construction materials, supported by a strong domestic and international supply network.
